details:
Currently, group owners have no official way to delete or disband their own groups. This feature is urgently needed as many communities become inactive or need to be permanently removed for various reasons.

Pain Points / Why This Feature is Needed:

1. No closure for inactive groups: When a community is no longer active, the group remains permanently in the system, cluttering UI for both the owner and its members.

2. Cumbersome manual "workaround": The only current method to simulate a deletion is for the owner to manually kick every member one by one (which is extremely time-consuming for large groups) and then leave the group themselves. However, this still leaves an empty group shell in the system that cannot be removed.

3. Additional issue for non-owner admins: Group administrators who are not owners lack a complete overview of all members, making it impossible for them to assist in cleaning up members even if allowed to do so. The only workaround — requiring the owner to handle everything alone — is inefficient and burdensome.

Proposed Solution:

Add a "Delete Group" or "Disband Group" option in the group settings page, accessible only by the group owner. This action should ideally include a confirmation dialog and (if possible) automatically remove the group from the profiles of all members.

Additional Context:

Group owners already have exclusive permissions in certain scenarios, such as closing group instances where only the owner can perform that action. Extending this exclusive access to include a deletion function would follow the same principle and greatly improve group management.

Thank you for considering this feature request.
title: Request to Add "Delete Group" or "Disband Group" Feature for Group Owners
